notes: Added recovery, TTL expiration worker, and test coverage stories to complete feature.

GOV-F-003-S69.title: TTL Expiration and Cleanup Worker
GOV-F-003-S69.description: Implement a background mechanism to identify and clean up expired locks based on expires_at. Ensure expired locks are treated as non-existent during acquisition and are eventually purged to prevent buildup.

GOV-F-003-S70.title: Lock Recovery and Reassignment Logic
GOV-F-003-S70.description: Implement recovery logic allowing a new owner to safely acquire a lock if the previous owner has exceeded TTL or failed mid-execution. Include validation to prevent race conditions and duplicate execution.

GOV-F-003-S71.title: Lock Conflict and Error Handling Standardization
GOV-F-003-S71.description: Define and enforce standardized error responses for lock conflicts, expired ownership, and invalid release attempts across all lock APIs to ensure predictable system behavior.

GOV-F-003-S72.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Lock TTL and Recovery
GOV-F-003-S72.description: Develop comprehensive unit and integration tests covering lock acquisition, expiration, recovery, concurrent access, and failure scenarios to validate correctness under load.
